notes: The served counts and denominators match the held source. The source outcome is Ketoacidosis, not specifically Diabetic ketoacidosis; Table 2 states: Includes one event of ketoacidosis in a participant without diabetes at baseline. Table 2 reports participants with event and prints 0.2% for empagliflozin and 0.0% for placebo; the narrative 0.09 versus 0.02 values are rates per 100 patient-years, not percentages. Denominators are the randomized groups, with all analyses performed by intention to treat. The held full text identifies itself as PMC7614055, whereas row.json.source cites PMC9761906; its PMID is 36331190.
